title: Implement Game Loop and State Controller
description: Develop the main game loop controller managing state transitions (Start, Playing, Paused, GameOver), delta time calculations, rendering coordination, and audio/score integration. Include unit tests for state machine transitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Game loop correctly transitions between Start, Playing, and GameOver states
Delta time calculations maintain consistent update intervals
reviewFeedback: The game loop and state controller implementation is clean, modular, immutable in its state transitions (aside from internal engine time state management which is standard for game loops), and includes comprehensive unit test coverage verifying delta time capping, state transitions, and requestAnimationFrame behavior.
